title: Forecourt — Free Bootstrap 6 Car Dealership Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 car dealership template — vehicle cards led by the monthly payment, a live finance calculator that updates every listing, part exchange and a full vehicle page.
yoastTitle: Forecourt — Free Bootstrap 6 Car Dealership Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 car dealership and automotive website template with monthly-payment-led vehicle cards, a live finance calculator using Range sliders, part-exchange valuation form, branch hours and a full vehicle listing page.
intro: Forecourt is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 website template for car dealerships, used-car forecourts, vehicle brokers and garages. It pairs a full dealership homepage — stock search, vehicle grid, finance calculator, part exchange and branches — with a vehicle listing page carrying a complete specification and a sticky finance rail.
note: The design leads with the number people actually shop on: the monthly payment is the largest figure on every card and the cash price sits beneath it. The finance calculator is genuinely live — move the deposit, term or APR sliders and every quoted monthly on the page updates with them, including all six cards in the grid, because a calculator that does not change the listings is decoration. The figures are flat-rate illustrations and the template says so in three places rather than dressing an approximation up as a quotation.
summary: Forecourt is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 template for car dealerships and used-car forecourts. The homepage runs a photographic showroom hero with a three-field stock search, a vehicle grid where every card leads with the monthly payment, a live finance calculator built on three Range sliders that recalculates every quoted figure on the page, a part-exchange valuation form using Combobox and Datepicker, and branch opening hours. The vehicle page adds a gallery strip, full specification in two columns, honest condition notes and a sticky finance rail with a booking dialog. Showroom design language: deep graphite, one signal-orange accent. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — dealership homepage and a vehicle listing page
Every vehicle card leads with the monthly payment, cash price secondary
Live finance calculator — deposit, term and APR sliders update every quoted figure on the page
Same formula runs at build and at runtime, so nothing jumps on first paint
Flat-rate figures labelled as illustrations, not dressed up as quotations
Part-exchange valuation form with Combobox condition and Datepicker
Vehicle page with gallery strip, two-column specification and a sticky finance rail
Booking dialog built on a native <dialog>
Branch opening hours and FCA regulatory footer
Bootstrap 6 vendored at a pinned commit, ESM-only, no build step
